name: Extract activities (bulk)
summary: Export a range of activities (form fills, page views, status changes, …) to a CSV/TSV/SSV file. Requires a date range of 31 days or fewer; optionally narrow to activity types or specific assets.
whenToUse: CRM syncs, ETL, data warehousing, or archiving large activity history. Use the normal 'Get Lead Activities' call for quick lookups of a few leads.
notes: The 'Delete Lead' activity type is not supported here — use the 'Get Deleted Leads' call instead.
Date range must be 31 days or fewer; datetimes are ISO-8601 without milliseconds.
Jobs run asynchronously — the file is usually ready within minutes.
If you filter by primary attribute (a specific form/list/program), you must also select matching activity types.
Export files are kept by Marketo for 10 days.

form.name: endAt
form.label: Activities created to
form.hint: The range must be 31 days or fewer.

form.name: activityTypeIds
form.label: Activity types (optional)
form.hint: Leave empty to include all activity types. Find IDs in the 'Activities' group (List activity types).

form.name: primaryAttributeValueIds
form.label: Only for specific assets — by ID (optional, advanced)
form.hint: Up to 50 IDs of forms, static lists, programs, or lead fields. Requires activity types above to be set. Mutually exclusive with the names option.

form.name: primaryAttributeValues
form.label: Only for specific assets — by name (optional, advanced)
form.hint: Up to 50 names. Program/list/form assets use '<program>.<name>' notation, e.g. GL_OP_ALL.MPS Outbound. Requires activity types above to be set. Mutually exclusive with the ID option.

form.name: fields
form.label: Columns (optional — advanced)
form.hint: Leave empty for the standard columns (marketoGUID, leadId, activityDate, activityTypeId, campaignId, primaryAttributeValueId, primaryAttributeValue, attributes). Allowed names: those plus actionResult.
